resources.string: Use the master password to open an independent encrypted configuration. Original files and data are kept. Fingerprint unlock and automatic Bitwarden sync are turned off; older Monica versions cannot open this recovery mode. Data that still needs a missing device key may remain unreadable. After recovery, export and verify an independent encrypted backup.

This installation uses password recovery mode. Enter the master password to open its encrypted configuration, then complete normal Monica sign-in. This does not confirm that every historical item is readable.
Reset is unavailable in password recovery mode to preserve the only unlock path. Export and verify an independent encrypted backup before resetting the installation through Android settings.
